# AI coding guidelines for this repo

- **App structure**: Next.js App Router with public routes in [app/(root)](app/(root)), auth pages in [app/(auth)](app/(auth)), admin surface in [admin](admin), plus API routes under [app/api](app/api). Global providers/fonts/theme/toasts/uploadthing SSR plugin live in [app/layout.tsx](app/layout.tsx); session context for client components is in [app/providers.tsx](app/providers.tsx); the storefront shell (header/nav/footer) is composed in [app/(root)/layout.tsx](app/(root)/layout.tsx).
- **Auth**: NextAuth JWT strategy with Prisma adapter in [auth.ts](auth.ts); sign-in/error pages are `/login`; role is stored on the token/session (types in [types/next-auth.d.ts](types/next-auth.d.ts)). Route guards for redirects/admin checks are in [lib/auth-guard.ts](lib/auth-guard.ts). Credentials authorize currently short-circuits bcrypt compare (set to `true`).
- **Database**: Prisma schema in [prisma/schema.prisma](prisma/schema.prisma) targeting Postgres (Neon). Client is generated to [lib/generated/prisma](lib/generated/prisma) and instantiated with the Neon adapter/websockets in [db/prisma.ts](db/prisma.ts); price/rating/monetary fields are coerced to strings via `$extends` results—avoid re-serializing Decimals manually.
- **Data fetching pattern**: Prefer the server actions in [lib/actions](lib/actions) (all `"use server"`) over ad-hoc Prisma calls; many revalidate paths and invalidate caches. Product/order/user/cart actions already handle validation, cache busting, and side-effects (UploadThing deletes, vector index, etc.).
- **Caching**: Upstash Redis helper [lib/cache/redis.ts](lib/cache/redis.ts) wraps `getCachedData` with TTLs and key builders; invalidation helpers exist per domain (products/categories/orders/cart). Cached values are JSON-stringified; store only serializable data.
- **Search**: Product search defaults to SQL relevance; pass `useVectorSearch` to [getAllProducts](lib/actions/product.actions.ts) to delegate to vector search. Vector embeddings use HuggingFace free model + Upstash Vector, with fallbacks in [lib/actions/vector-search.actions.ts](lib/actions/vector-search.actions.ts); sync helpers exist for bulk upserts.
- **Media/uploads**: UploadThing SSR plugin is wired in [app/layout.tsx](app/layout.tsx) with router config from [app/api/uploadthing/core](app/api/uploadthing/core). Remote image allowlist is defined in [next.config.ts](next.config.ts) (utfs.io/uploadthing hosts).
- **Cart/session**: `middleware.ts` seeds a `sessionCartId` cookie for guests. Cart mutations in [lib/actions/cart.actions.ts](lib/actions/cart.actions.ts) require that cookie, merge with authed carts, validate via Zod, recompute totals with `round2`, invalidate Redis, and `revalidatePath` product/cart pages. Avoid calling without the cookie present.
- **Orders**: [lib/actions/order.actions.ts](lib/actions/order.actions.ts) creates orders from the current cart and user profile (must have address/payment method), deletes the cart, and returns redirect targets. Payment updates run inside a transaction, decrement stock, and optionally send receipts.
- **Users**: [lib/actions/user.actions.ts](lib/actions/user.actions.ts) wraps sign-in/up, profile updates, and admin user management. `signOutUser` deletes the current cart before signing out to avoid leaking carts across sessions.
- **Constants & defaults**: Shared defaults and limits (pagination sizes, default form values, payment methods, env-driven values) live in [lib/constants/index.ts](lib/constants/index.ts). Respect `PAGE_SIZE`, `DB_ADMIN_*` limits, `PAYMENT_METHODS`, and `SERVER_URL` when adding features.
- **Utilities**: Use helpers in [lib/utils.ts](lib/utils.ts) for currency/number formatting, error normalization (Zod/Prisma), Decimal serialization (`serializeOrderForClient`, `serializeDashboardStats`), and querystring helpers for pagination.
- **Routing protection**: Authorization callback in [auth.ts](auth.ts) restricts `/shipping-address`, `/payment-method`, `/place-order`, `/user`, `/order`, `/admin`, `/profile`. Use `requireAuth`/`requireAdmin` from [lib/auth-guard.ts](lib/auth-guard.ts) inside server components/actions instead of duplicating logic.
- **Vector search toggle UI**: Admin/product forms expose vector sync toggles (components under [components/admin](components/admin)); keep vector index in sync when creating/updating/deleting products via the provided actions.
- **Environment variables**: Requires `DATABASE_URL` (Neon), `UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL/TOKEN`, `UPSTASH_VECTOR_REST_URL/TOKEN`, NextAuth provider secrets, UploadThing keys, HuggingFace API key, and any payment keys. Prisma commands are wrapped with `dotenv -e .env -- ...` in package scripts.
- **Dev workflows**: `npm run dev` for app, `npm run build` for prod, `npm run analyze` or `npm run build:analyze` for bundle stats, `npm run db:generate|db:push|db:migrate|db:studio` for Prisma (loads .env). Path alias `@/*` is configured in [tsconfig.json](tsconfig.json).
- **Data/price handling**: Many API responses expect stringified money values (see cart/order serializers); when adding fields, ensure consistent string conversion to avoid serialization errors in React Server Components.
- **UI conventions**: Tailwind is used throughout; global styles in [app/globals.css](app/globals.css) and [assets/styles/globals.css](assets/styles/globals.css). Keep storefront layout using the header/nav/footer composition in [app/(root)/layout.tsx](app/(root)/layout.tsx).
- **Testing/validation**: Forms typically validate with Zod schemas in [lib/validators.ts](lib/validators.ts) and error messaging uses `formatError`; reuse these schemas instead of hand-rolling validation.
- **When unsure**: Prefer adding or extending server actions in [lib/actions](lib/actions) and keep cache invalidation + `revalidatePath` aligned with existing patterns; ensure new data flows respect auth guards and cart/order invariants described above.
